romans.11.p1.b1.text: I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself …

romans.11.p1.b2.text: “Lord … I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well”

romans.11.p1.b3.text: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.

romans.11.p2.b1.text: What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did …

romans.11.p2.b2.text: God gave them a spirit of stupor … to this very day.

romans.11.p3.b1.text: I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not!

romans.11.p3.b2.text: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry

romans.11.p3.b3.text: … what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

romans.11.p4.b1.text: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,

romans.11.p4.b2.text: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.

romans.11.p4.b3.text: … If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.

romans.11.p5.b1.text: Take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of God … kindness to you, if you continue in His kindness.

romans.11.p5.b2.text: … for God is able to graft them in again.

romans.11.p5.b3.text: … how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!

romans.11.p6.b1.text: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited …

romans.11.p6.b2.text: And so all Israel will be saved

romans.11.p6.b3.text: For God’s gifts and His call are irrevocable.
